description: This PHP test file defines a unit test class 'DauxHelperTest' for testing the 'DauxHelper' class's 'getFilenames' method within the 'Todaymade\Daux' namespace. It uses PHPUnit framework for assertions and includes a data provider 'providerGetFilenames' to supply test cases.

classes.name: DauxHelperTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing DauxHelper's filename generation logic.

methods.name: providerGetFilenames
methods.description: Provides test data for testing filename retrieval logic, returning pairs of filename expectations and input nodes.

methods.name: testGetFilenames
methods.description: Unit test method that asserts the correctness of 'DauxHelper::getFilenames' using data from the provider.
